scope: Prespecified descriptive examples and diagnostics for completed main runs. Main outcomes do not select training configurations.

selection_rules.typical_terminal: Valid natural-EOS output nearest median reward among valid terminal samples, deterministic identity/index tie break. Report all-attempt validity separately; this is not an all-attempt median if invalid outputs exist.
selection_rules.best_discovered: Highest-reward distinct search candidate, canonical-string tie break; explicitly an extreme example.
selection_rules.component_tradeoff: Highest aggregate reward among distinct search candidates having at least one normalized component below 0.5. If none exists, report none, do not relax threshold.
selection_rules.closest_terminal_pair: Most similar pair among all unique valid terminal molecules using Morgan radius2 2048-bit Tanimoto. It is an extreme pair, not average diversity.
selection_rules.failure: First invalid/disconnected/truncated search attempt in original order; display failure metadata instead of inventing a molecular structure. If no failure, report none.

coverage: All methods and seeds shown when raw completed-run ledgers are available; missing runs explicitly listed.
metrics: exact unique-output fingerprint diversity using all pairs
boundaries: No claim of binding, drug efficacy, novelty, safety or synthetic accessibility from these proxies
Do not select only attractive chemical structures
Do not interpret a selected extreme pair as evidence of global collapse
Do not pool terminal samples as independent training replicates
No clipping or removal of inconvenient valid molecules
timing: Rules written after first formal summary scores were known, before inspecting or selecting individual molecular cases. This is exploratory case analysis, not preregistration before the main experiment.
